Modern social-first product photography with tactile, editorial energy. Minimal processing -- the product looks like it does in your hand. Slight warmth in highlights, lifted shadows keeping everything airy. One accent color pops against neutral base.

No BGM, no music. Generate only dialogue, environmental sounds, and action sounds.

detailed_description:

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, the video begins with <Picture 1>. <Subject 2> walks against the flow of traffic on the downtown crosswalk, filming herself with her smartphone in one hand while keeping a white coffee cup steady in the other. The camera uses a brisk, lively handheld follow, tracking her movement as the city comes alive with moving cars and pedestrians in the background, ensuring her face remains sharp and focused.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a reactive handheld drift. <Subject 2> grabs her scarf as a gust of wind catches it. <Subject 4> enters the frame and reaches out to steady her cup just as the lid pops loose. A playful, natural jolt captures the near-spill, revealing a small coral mark from <Subject 3> on the cup rim. 

[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera transitions to a smooth, quick handheld follow. <Subject 2> uses her thumb to wipe the tiny coral mark from the rim of the cup and continues walking. She glances directly into the camera with a casual, "check-in" expression. <Subject 2> (S2) says <d>[English] Still here.</d>
